dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course. Would you like me to think of a topic?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hmm... However, I am not exactly the sort of person that can carry a conversation... I believe that much about myself.

choices.text: Hardly! You're very good at talking to others, Lauma.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I'm sorry to disappoint you... It is because of my duties that I must speak those words of comfort and encouragement.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Words carry a wondrous power, so people tend to say whatever is appropriate to a conversation. I am no different.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Now that we're on the subject, I suppose I would like to become a more proficient communicator...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can always learn from your friends.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: ...Ah, yes. Ms. Nefer, Mr. Varka, and Mr. Flins come to mind.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: They are all clever and wise individuals. Having come from different backgrounds, their ways of speech also differ.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Meeting them has shown me the extent of my abilities. I still have much to learn.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But maybe there's a lot they can learn from you in return.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Hmm... You're right, I suppose there might be.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: At least in terms of communicating with animals, I know I definitely have the upper hand.

choices.text: It's alright. I'm not much of a talker either.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Oh, hardly... I've seen the way you talk to others. You're doing just fine.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Although Paimon often speaks in your stead, I find your words often fascinating. I've been paying special attention to them, you know.
